name: Revari's Mother
description: The ghost of Emilio Revari's mother, a clawed, needle-toothed old woman who haunts her manor and guards her own hidden corpse.

timeline.summary: Kaya taunts the spirit and the ghost appears in the east wing hallway, a clawed old woman, and shrieks at her.
timeline.quote: A spectral form appeared most of the way down the hallway

timeline.summary: Kaya phases through the wall to dodge the ghost and pins its shawl to the wall with a dagger.
timeline.quote: She lit up one of her daggers and pinned the shawl to the wall.

timeline.summary: Kaya stabs the ghost through the palm and wounds it, and it flees through the ceiling.
timeline.quote: Kaya blocked with the other dagger, stabbing it through the ghost's gnarled palm.

timeline.summary: Kaya grabs the ghost's spectral shawl to catch a ride out of the pit.
timeline.quote: closed spectral hands around the spectral shawl

timeline.summary: Kaya pries up floorboards in the wrecked tea room and finds the withered corpse of an old woman resembling the ghost.
timeline.quote: There, in the crawlspace, was the withered corpse of an old woman.

timeline.summary: Kaya confronts Revari, calling him kinslayer, as his mother's ghost appears behind him.
timeline.quote: I don't want anything from you, kinslayer,

timeline.summary: The ghost falls on Revari with teeth and claws as Kaya walks through the door and leaves him screaming.
timeline.quote: Then his mother's wailing ghost was upon him with those needle teeth and those dagger claws.

relations.note: She is his mother, whom he suspects refuses to leave the manor.
Kaya accuses him of kinslayer after finding the hidden corpse and his ring.
relations.quote: I don't want anything from you, kinslayer,

relations.note: She fights and wounds the ghost before learning why it haunts the house.
relations.quote: Kaya blocked with the other dagger, stabbing it through the ghost's gnarled palm.
